purpose: User-oriented Plotly-style dashboard workflow for connection refresh, chart creation, governed image saving, specific-image extraction, shared-time stacking and explicit export.

workflow.label: 連線與更新
workflow.success: A read-only refresh request ID is appended to the ledger.
workflow.truthBoundary: REQUESTED_RUNTIME is not CONNECTED or UPDATED.

workflow.label: 新增圖
workflow.success: A loaded Catalog table and numeric fields are selected.

workflow.label: 繪好圖
workflow.success: A single-axis or dual-axis governed SVG is rendered with semantic metadata.

workflow.label: 儲存圖像
workflow.success: SVG, chart contract and SHA-256 are stored in IndexedDB; LocalStorage stores metadata only.

workflow.label: 擷取特定圖
workflow.success: Search, filtered select-all, exact single extraction and SHA verification are available.

workflow.label: 堆圖編排
workflow.success: Selected images are deduplicated, ordered, height-scaled from 0.5x to 4x and aligned to a strict shared timeline.

workflow.label: 預覽與匯出
workflow.success: The stack is previewed; HTML, PNG, PDF or JSON export starts only after an explicit user action.

refreshContract.successCondition: At least one response table passes the Catalog quality gate.
